coordinates: glTF: +Y up. Blender build axes map as X->X, Y->-Z, Z->Y. Machine forward = +X.
rule: Each joint node's origin is its real pivot. Rotate/translate the node about/along 'axis' in its parent space by 'value'. rest = value at which the exported GLB was saved. 'scale' joints scale along 'axis'.

joints.use: Hoist position. Origin = skip bottom centre. Skip body 9 m + bridle; rope attaches 12.8 m above origin.

Bottom-dump door, hinged at its LOWER edge (0.55 m above the skip origin, +X side). Positive tilts it down and out: the bottom opens and the door becomes the discharge chute. Drive it from skip height so the dump rollers stay in the scrolls: door = 110deg * s(h_rel/4.0), s(t)=t*t*(3-2t) clamped 0..1, h_rel = skip_origin_z - DumpScrolls_origin_z.
Fill level: 0.001 = empty, 1 = full.

EQ_Skip.notes: Bottom-dump skip, 2.0 x 1.7 m, guide shoes on +/-Y. Floor slopes down to the bottom discharge opening on +X. Dump rollers on the door arms stick out 0.55 m beyond each side (+/-Y) to run in EQ_DumpScrolls.

EQ_DumpScrolls.notes: Fixed curved rails (scrolls) for the headframe, one each side of the skip compartment. Origin = skip ORIGIN height at which the rollers enter the scrolls (x, y = shaft centre). The skip reaches the full-dump position 4.0 m higher. The rail shape is generated from the same door formula given for SK_Skip_Door, so rollers and rails always match.

EQ_LoadingChute.notes: Origin = back of the fixed hopper. Place so the lip tip (x = +2.5 at rest) is over the skip opening.

aim_stretch.how: barrel (or cable) node: rotate so its local 'aim' axis points at the target node's world position (q = rotationBetween(aim, normalize(target - barrel_origin) in parent space)). rod node: translate along 'aim' by (distance - rest_length). Keep distance between min_length and max_length.

cables.use: aim the node's local 'aim' axis at the connector tail and scale along it by distance/rest_length

shaft_layout.origin: cage compartment centre at station floor level (same origin as EQ_ShaftStationBarrier)
shaft_layout.fit: EQ_CageCounterweight origin -> Counterweight centre (it moves opposite the cage: cw_z = top_z + bottom_z - cage_z). EQ_PersonnelCage origin -> Cage centre (boarding side faces the landing). EQ_Skip origin -> Skip1 / Skip2 centres (skip guides on the compartment's long sides). Rotate EQ_LoadingChute so its lip extends through the Skip gate toward the skip.
shaft_layout.replaces: EQ_ShaftBarrier_Gate (single-compartment) is kept only for the stand-alone skip demo.
